title: Cai Fun with Pork
description: A classic Chinese dish featuring stir-fried pork and cai fun noodles. Quick and easy to make, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the pork from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the wok.
Add the chopped cai and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the wok and stir to combine with the cai.
Return the pork to the wok and stir in the soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the pork is coated in the sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions.
